# Tier 1 — Core Medications
These medications are always useful to Medbay. Often, you'll see them produced right at the beginning of the shift.
Be warned that Saline and Dexalin Plus will severely poison [textlink="Avali" link="Avali"] and [textlink="Resomi" link="Resomi"]. Alternatives such as Amoxla, Tirimol, and Artiplates are used for them instead.
Cryoxadone and Doxarubixadone are used with [textlink="Cryogenics" link="Cryogenics"], but they are easy to make and extremely versatile.
Although not often directly made, these reagents below are found in Medbay at the beginning of the shift.
These are weak prerequisites to the core medications. Kelotane mixed with Dermaline can help to alleviate Dermaline's low overdose threshold.
